description: Register a new webhook endpoint to receive real-time event notifications. The URL must be HTTPS. Specify which event types to subscribe to (comment.received, dm.received, review.received, mention.received, post.published, post.failed, post.scheduled). The signing secret is returned once -- store it securely to verify payload signatures (HMAC-SHA256).
